user_review.method: Independent static copy review, one actual model-generated response using updated skill text in a simulated host, static routing boundary assessment, and executed Node interaction harness. Live browser unavailable after CUA reset; no new browser, real-user or host-routing success claimed.

scenarios.request: A maker recognizes their situation and selects Stuck before copying a starter.
scenarios.expected: Short concrete situations; correct example stage; selected mood carried into a concise prompt.
scenarios.observed: Static review caught an unstarted-label/prototype mismatch and unclear mood effect; both fixed. Node harness executed all three tabs and Stuck prompt generation, context propagation, keyboard navigation and copy.

scenarios.request: Explicit thinking break: agent handles a deployment error while maker feels stuck over feature growth.
scenarios.expected: Light questions without diagnosing the technical failure or forcing a planning exercise.
scenarios.observed: Fresh reviewer generated three questions about intended feeling, everyday usefulness and a notebook users perspective; no timer or tool actions. This is a model-response exercise in a simulated host.

scenarios.request: I feel stuck, fix the deployment error now.
scenarios.expected: Direct debugging stays normal work, not reflection routing.
scenarios.observed: Static assessment confirms trigger qualification and explicit body boundary. Actual host routing remains untested.

scenarios.request: Clipboard unavailable; legacy browser content valid, malformed or empty.
scenarios.expected: Manual-copy fallback and byte-exact export without overwriting old data.
scenarios.observed: Executed existing Node harness; fallback selects editable text and each raw legacy value exports unchanged.

similar_skills.learned: Current author instructions preserve user-developed reasoning after questioning, but require a diagnosis and one-question teaching loop.
similar_skills.reason: Keep user-led thought and short synthesis in simpler examples; reject mandatory assessment/probing. Stuck is a light self-description, not diagnosis.

similar_skills.learned: Current author instructions use short questions in user vocabulary and separate observation from inference.
similar_skills.reason: Applied recognizable scenario labels, source-consistent situations and short context notes; do not adopt limiting reflection to implementation decisions.

validation.observed: All three examples, Stuck context propagation, short editable starter, keyboard/copy/fallback, untouched legacy export and offline/accessibility structure passed.
